done_when: README.md says this is KnackLabs' private trial client for Forge and that forge next gives the next step

dismissals.because: tests/readme.test.sh:5 a README-only change needs no test; the repo has no code or test runner yet, so there is nothing to wire it into

findings.body: The new script is never invoked by the repository's test suite. `forge.toml:5` and `.github/workflows/forge.yml:21` both use `[ ! -f package.json ] || (npm ci && npm test)`. With no `package.json` present, these checks succeed without testing the README, so removing its required content would leave CI green. Wire this script into the configured suite and CI to satisfy the test-audit requirement.
findings.title: Not done: README test runs in the repository's test suite

why: The repo has no README, so a visitor can't tell what it is or how to work in it
